about_the_game:
[A 3D First-Person Cyberpunk Stealth Simulation Game with Dual-Character Collaboration at its Core.]

 

From corporate puppet to urban legend, you clutch the only spark of hope, the last shred of conscience.

 

In Neo-Lumina City, your very consciousness is not your own—it's merely a line of data on the Hermes Corporation's ledger. When top scientist Ava Rose witnesses the ugly truth beneath this glamorous hell, she chooses to take the one child capable of igniting the darkness and leap into the abyss.

 

Will you pursue escape fueled by the promise of Redemption, or will you choose Revenge fueled by the simmering rage of the forgotten?

 

Every step you take together etches a mark of humanity into the cold data flow. Every choice you make will decide whether the city welcomes a true dawn or plunges into an eternal digital night. Hold his hand tight—your path to salvation is the world's genesis of rebirth.

 

◤ STRATEGIC CHOICES, FLEXIBLE SOLUTIONS ◢

On your desperate flight, you will freely switch between the defector scientist Madam Rust (Ava) and the child with data-sensing abilities, Echo (Xiao Yuan).

 

Madam Rust: Wield psychic manipulation to immobilize human enemies or command them to act on your behalf. In moments of desperation, deploy an ultimate skill to turn the tide.

 

Echo: Utilize data synchronization to interfere with and control synthetic sentries, rendering you invisible to them. You can also perceive the location of all surrounding enemies, allowing you to preempt threats. But be cautious: every use of this power may accelerate the final dissolution of your consciousness. Will you seize the power, or safeguard your humanity?

 

◤ DISGUISE AND STEALTH: NAVIGATE UNDER ENEMY EYES ◢

Blend into the Crowd: Disguise yourself as an ordinary pedestrian. But remember—frequent glances, lingering in one spot, or sudden bursts of running will trigger suspicion.

 

Dynamic Threats: Evade fixed synthetic sentries and avoid regular patrol routes. More critically, be wary of plainclothes agents whose erratic behavior allows them to blend into the crowds. If suspicion is raised, you must quickly regain your composure or use a skill to escape, or the chase will begin instantly!

 

The Art of Escape: Even when spotted, you still hAva a chance. Use your skills to create openings, shake off your pursuers, and find a new lifeline in the neon-drenched shadows of the streets.

 

◤ CRUMBS OF CLUES, LIGHTING THE WAY ◢

Uncover High-Value Secrets: Discover hidden paths known only to the informed—vaulting across a visual blind spot on an overhead bridge or taking a shortcut through a bustling boxing ring. Outsmart, don't outfight, and become a legend of the urban shadow.

 

Weave Your Resistance Network: Accept side missions scattered throughout the city to deliver crucial intelligence to the underground resistance. Every act of assistance you provide may quietly shift the balance of power.

 

Sift Truth from Traps: The city is marked by guiding signals from allies, but it is also riddled with fatal traps and corporate snares. Do you trust the clues or your gut feeling? Every choice of direction is a test of life and death.

 

◤ FORGE YOUR LEGEND ◢

Challenge the Ranks, Break the Ceiling: Claim your spot on the global leaderboards! Compete for achievements like "Least Skills Used" or "Most Powerful Combo" to prove you are the premier stealth master of Neo-Lumina City.

 

Record and Share Your Peak Moments: Use the built-in advanced recording tool to instantly capture thrilling moments. Automatically generate your own "Escape Comic Strips" or high-octane video clips. Every god-tier move you make can be easily converted into a short video and shared to social media, making you the center of attention.

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA RTX 2080,AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
